scope: Frozen negative BCE weight intervention before fitting. Original data/labels and matched-control recipes retained; no endpoint treatment, mining, audio/speed or runtime change.
hypothesis: In-sample near-word false clips persist in the frozen training-only diagnostic. Raising negative cost may improve separation, but can instead shift calibration or reduce recall; no benefit assumed.
control_policy: Preserved weight5 controls have identical initialization, seeds, steps, data rows/order, sampling and representative inputs. Verify exact representative hashes and prefit batches; only weighted loss differs.
combination: Independent member checkpoint selection on original validation; fixed equal mean and original threshold policy; freeze before existing development regression.
prespecified_advance_rule: No flash unless original-validation and frozen development results support improvement without losing positive recall/ordinary false-wake behavior; final/human/acoustic/resources/AEC acceptance still required.
limits: Single fixed fourfold increase in cost on the same data; not a hyperparameter search and not proof of a general optimum. Calibration uses the unchanged grid so probability shifts alone do not establish discrimination gains.
